findings.reason: "ले जा नहीं सकता" splits the compound verb ले जाना around the negative in an order that reads as a calque of the English word order; the idiomatic order is "नहीं ले जा सकता". "बातचीत ले नहीं सकता" for "cannot receive a move" can be misread as "cannot take (the) conversation"; "स्वीकार नहीं कर सकता" is unambiguous and matches the shipped "गंतव्य … सामग्री सुरक्षित रूप से नहीं ले सकता" register. Intelligible as written, hence NIT.
